description: Six comparisons and arithmetic operations on two voltages, all running at once

inputs.text: The first of the two voltages, called A on the panel
The second of the two voltages, called B on the panel

outputs.text: 5V while A is at or above B, 0V otherwise; it stays high rather than pulsing
5V while A and B are exactly equal, 0V otherwise; it stays high rather than pulsing
The lower of the two voltages
The higher of the two voltages
The two voltages multiplied, on a scale where 5V stands for 1, so two 5V inputs give 5V out
The length of the hypotenuse of a right triangle whose two shorter sides are A and B, on a scale where 5V stands for 1

notes: the two equality outputs are compared with no tolerance at all, so two voltages that differ in the last decimal place read as unequal.
nothing here is clamped, so the multiply and the hypotenuse can pass 5V when both inputs do.

inputs.0:
one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
